description: List this workspace catalog categories as a flat array, each with id, name, slug, parentId (null for a root category), description, googleProductCategory, imageUrl, translations and marketplaceCategories (the Prom, Rozetka, OLX, Amazon and Google Merchant category ids already linked, each as { id, label } or null). Categories are workspace-global, not per warehouse. Use a category id here as the categoryId for create_product/update_product, or as the search_products category filter. Use get_category for one category's product and subcategory counts, and search_marketplace_categories to find a marketplace category id to link.
name: list_categories
title: List categories
